source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on phase 2 of the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 16
statement: A control API request is strict: an operation either version's control-sdk writes, either version's control plane reads alike, and one with a member a control plane does not know is refused by it (400), never read as an operation that does less.
guards: compat:ControlApiCompatTest#a proposal either version's client writes, either version's control plane reads alike
compat:ControlApiCompatTest#an operation with a member a control plane does not know is refused by it
